meta.title: 10 Minute Delivery Ka Asli Raaz: Dark Store
meta.fullVoiceover: 10 minute me delivery? Rider ki speed ka isse koi lena-dena nahi! Asli raaz: dark store, yani tumhare area ke paas ek chhota warehouse, jahan saaman pehle se rakha hota hai. Order aaya, pack hua, rider nikla. Bas! Blinkit ke aise 2,751 dark stores hain, aur Instamart ke 1,240. Par twist: ek quarter me Instamart ko 895 crore ka loss, jabki Blinkit 184 crore profit me. Pro tip: order se pehle fees check karo, rush mehnga pad sakta hai. Follow karo @techwith.GenZ.

🤯 10 minute me delivery ka raaz rider ki speed nahi, dark store hai! 👇

🏭 Dark store = tumhare area ke paas ek chhota warehouse, jahan saaman pehle se rakha hota hai
⚡ Order aaya, pack hua, rider nikla. Bas!
📍 Blinkit: 2,751 dark stores | Instamart: 1,240 (Jul-Sep 2026 quarter)

😳 Twist: speed ki keemat badi hai
• Instamart: ₹895 crore ka adjusted EBITDA loss (ek quarter)
• Blinkit: ₹184 crore ka adjusted EBITDA profit

💡 Pro tip: order karne se pehle cart me fees check karo. 10 minute ka rush mehnga pad sakta hai.
